## Hosting {#hosting}

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc. When you open a page, GitHub processes the technical data needed to deliver it, including your IP address, and may log it for security purposes. This is based on the legitimate interest in providing the website securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). GitHub may process these data in the United States; see the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement) for how it handles them.

## No cookies, analytics, or third-party content {#no-tracking}

This website sets no cookies and uses no analytics, tracking, or advertising. It loads no fonts, scripts, or media from other providers: everything is served from the website itself.

## Display preferences {#preferences}

If you use the light and dark mode switch, your browser remembers the choice in its local storage on your device. It is not transmitted to anyone, and you can delete it at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser.

## Email {#email}

If you write an email, your address and message are used only to answer you (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR). The address is an institutional account of Jena University Hospital, whose email service processes the messages.

## Your rights {#rights}

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and to object (Art. 15 to 21 GDPR). You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the Thüringer Landesbeauftragter für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit.
